build_dqn_network: build a double DQN or QR-DQN network using make_network with the desired network type and number of actions
create_dqn_conv_torso: create a convolutional torso for DQN using dqn_torso with three conv layers and ReLU activations
create_dqn_value_head: create a DQN value head with a hidden layer and optional shared bias using dqn_value_head
build_double_dqn_network: build a complete Double DQN Atari network with shared bias output using double_dqn_atari_network
build_qr_dqn_network: build a QR-DQN network that outputs quantile distributions using qr_atari_network with quantiles
